description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to build and maintain highly reliable, scalable, and secure OpenShift/Kubernetes clusters. We will need you to approach the problem of building and maintaining production systems from a software engineering perspective with a focus on automation, and reliability.


Key responsibilities:


- Build and automate and maintain OpenShift/Kubernetes clusters.

- Create and enhance tools to make operational workflows more automated.

- Configure and maintain additional required supporting infrastructure applications.

- Monitor, respond to, and resolve Cluster and infrastructure service issues.

- Handle infrastructure and services on prem and in AWS.

- Diagnose and resolve problems in OpenShift and/or Kubernetes clusters.

- Implement metrics to measure service performance and health.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience as a Site Reliability Engineer.

- Deep experience with Linux Administration.

- Automation experience with Python, Bash, Salt, or equivalent.

- Knowledge installing, managing, maintaining, and troubleshooting OpenShift/Kubernetes clusters.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Virtual Interior Designer / Stylist
description:
About Promethex AI

Promethex AI is a modern agency building AI-first, tech-forward teams that help fast-growing companies scale intelligently. We recruit, train, and manage talent across finance, logistics, production, marketing, creatives, technology, and customer experience—equipping them with advanced tools to deliver measurable impact.

We partner with leading luxury ecommerce and design-driven brands, giving our team members exposure to innovative industries and real opportunities for growth.

For this role, you will be dedicated to supporting a North American luxury ecommerce brand that has been in business for nearly 20 years. The company is a market leader with strong growth, a well-established reputation, and a wide customer base across the U.S. and Canada.


The Role

As a Virtual Interior Designer / Stylist , you will act as the creative director behind 3D product visualization. You’ll collaborate closely with the 3D rendering team to conceptualize and direct visually compelling room scenes, ensuring products are styled and positioned in ways that resonate with brand identity, current design trends, and customer lifestyles.

This role requires a strong sense of design aesthetics, market awareness, and the ability to translate brand essence into visually powerful interior concepts that help sell pieces through ecommerce and marketing channels.


What You’ll Do

  • Direct the creative styling and art direction for furniture renders and room scenes.
  • Develop styling concepts that reflect the brand’s identity and target audience.
  • Collaborate with 3D rendering artists to bring concepts to life with accuracy and visual impact.
  • Research and apply emerging interior design trends to keep visuals modern and market-relevant.
  • Select furniture pairings, color palettes, and décor elements to create balanced, compelling room settings.
  • Provide clear creative briefs and feedback to ensure renders meet styling and brand standards.
  • Work closely with marketing and product teams to align visuals with campaign goals and seasonal launches.
  • Incorporate AI-powered design and visualization tools into workflow where applicable.


What You’ll Need

  • 3+ years of experience in interior design, styling, or creative direction (ecommerce or furniture focus preferred).
  • Strong knowledge of interior trends, design aesthetics, and consumer preferences in North American markets.
  • Proven ability to create mood boards, style guides, and visual concepts.
  • Experience collaborating with 3D rendering teams or digital visualization workflows.
  • Excellent communication and feedback skills, with fluency in English for collaboration with North American teams.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple styling projects simultaneously.
  • AI-first mindset: openness to integrating AI tools for concepting, mood boarding, or visual enhancements.
  • Comfort working North American time zones.


Why Promethex AI?

  • Be part of an AI-first agency shaping the future of talent.
  • Work with a well-established North American brand with nearly 20 years in the market.
  • Access advanced AI and research tools to accelerate your work.
  • Competitive pay and growth opportunities across multiple product categories.
  • Remote-friendly, global team focused on innovation and measurable results.

title: Senior React Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Senior React Developer to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Build a framework for other developers to build applications with. Initially focusing on building reactive dashboards with an option to make mobile versions of them.

- Assist in coaching and mentoring other React developers.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Front End development with strong skills in Javascript, CSS3 and HTML5.

- 2+ of experience developing Web applications using ReactJS, Flux, Redux, Relay, etc.

- Experience using ES2015 (ES6 / ES7).

- Experience with command lines, APIs, and client-side performance.

- Familiar with the concepts of basic programming, JavaScript and data structures, types of variables and idiosyncrasies.

- Comfortable using debuggers and code tracking.

- Proven experience in the use of Jasmine or similar tools for Front End testing.

- Advanced English level.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer


Highlights

⚡ Work on scalable and innovative applications

Remote flexibility with global teams

Career growth in fast-paced technology environments


Role Summary

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our development team. You will help design, build, and maintain applications that power modern businesses, contributing across the full software lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

• Develop full-stack or back-end solutions with modern frameworks

• Work closely with product managers and designers on requirements

• Write clean, efficient, and testable code

• Participate in code reviews and engineering best practices

• Optimize applications for performance and scalability


Requirements

• Proficiency in Java, Python, JavaScript, or Go

• Familiarity with cloud platforms and containerization (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes)

• Experience with relational and NoSQL databases

• Strong understanding of version control (Git)

• Ability to thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment


Why Join Us

You’ll be working on products that make a real impact in the market. This role offers the chance to solve meaningful problems while advancing your technical expertise.


About Us

We are a global technology company building transformative software solutions. Our culture values innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) de Software focado em Agentes de IA e LLMs
description:
Na Data Science Brigade respiramos big data e ciência de dados. Estamos aqui para criar projetos que respondam de forma inteligente perguntas importantes para nossos clientes e os ajude a tomar decisões rapidamente a partir de dados.


Reunimos equipes multidisciplinares para resolver problemas reais sendo uma delas focada em criar ferramentas e interfaces que sirvam para que a comunicação entre os algoritmos e humanos seja a mais amigável e produtiva possível.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de Software talentoso(a) e apaixonado(a) por inovação para integrar nossa equipe e atuar no desenvolvimento de agentes de IA e aplicações baseadas em Large Language Models (LLMs). Você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos de alto impacto, utilizando tecnologias de ponta para criar soluções escaláveis e inteligentes que impulsionarão o sucesso de nossos clientes globais.


O Que Você Fará


  • Projetar e Desenvolver Agentes de IA: Realizar o desenvolvimento e manutenção de ferramentas e pipelines para agentes de IA, com foco em padrões como Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), function-calling e fluxos de trabalho multi-agente para diferentes modalidades (web, chat e voz).
  • Integração e Orquestração de LLMs: Integrar LLMs de forma eficiente, utilizando APIs, orquestradores de agentes (como LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack) e bancos de dados vetoriais (incluindo Pinecone, Weaviate e mongodb).
  • Construção de Interfaces Intuitivas: Criar interfaces de usuário (web ou chat) que promovam uma interação fluida entre humanos e agentes, incorporando métricas robustas de confiabilidade e observabilidade (prompt logging, avaliações automáticas e tracing com ferramentas como LangSmith ou OpenAI Evals).
  • Colaboração Multidisciplinar: Atuar em squads multidisciplinares (UX, Data Science, DevOps), participando de todas as fases do ciclo de vida do software, do discovery ao deploy contínuo em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Governança e Boas Práticas de IA: Colaborar ativamente na definição e implementação de boas práticas em prompt engineering, versionamento de modelos e governança de IA, garantindo a qualidade e ética das soluções desenvolvidas.


Requisitos Essenciais


  • Experiência Sólida em Desenvolvimento Backend: Proficiência comprovada em linguagens como Python ou TypeScript/Node.js, e experiência com frameworks web robustos (ex: FastAPI, Django, Rails, NestJS, Express.js).
  • Conhecimento de Frameworks de Agentes/LLMs: Familiaridade e experiência prática com frameworks de orquestração de LLMs e agentes (ex: LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI ou equivalentes).
  • Engenharia de Software e Qualidade: Domínio de Git/GitHub e fluxo Gitflow, experiência com testes automatizados (PyTest, RSpec, Jest) e implementação de CI/CD.
  • Banco de Dados: Forte domínio de SQL e modelagem de dados em bancos relacionais, além de compreensão sólida de bancos de dados NoSQL e bancos vetoriais.
  • Princípios de Código Limpo: Aplicação de princípios de Programação Orientada a Objetos (POO), Design Patterns e Clean Code.
  • Prompt Engineering: Experiência prática e sólida compreensão das técnicas de prompt engineering para otimização do desempenho e comportamento de LLMs.
  • Inglês Técnico: Capacidade de ler e escrever documentação técnica e de APIs em inglês.


Diferenciais


  • Desenvolvimento de Voz e Multimodal: Experiência com projetos em produção envolvendo tecnologias de voz (Twilio, Amazon Connect, Azure Speech) e agentes TTS/STT (Whisper, AssemblyAI).
  • Desenvolvimento Frontend: Experiência com frameworks modernos de frontend, como React/Next.js, Vue.js/Nuxt.js ou Svelte, para a construção de interfaces ricas.
  • Infraestrutura e DevOps: Conhecimento de ferramentas de infraestrutura como código e orquestração de containers (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible).
  • Avaliação e Fine-tuning de Modelos: Experiência com fine-tuning ou instrução de modelos (LoRA, PEFT) e ferramentas de avaliação de qualidade de LLMs (LLM-Evals, Promptbench, Ragas).
  • Ambiente Linux e Cultura DevOps: Vivência em ambientes Linux/Unix e sólida compreensão da cultura DevOps.
  • Autonomia e Trabalho Remoto: Forte autonomia, excelentes habilidades de comunicação assíncrona e afinidade com um ambiente de trabalho 100% remoto.


O Que Oferecemos


  • Flexibilidade e Remoto: Horário flexível e trabalho 100% remoto, com a opção de utilizar nosso escritório em Porto Alegre (RS) se preferir.
  • Time de Especialistas: Oportunidade de atuar em um time sênior e altamente qualificado, com um forte compromisso com a mentoria e o crescimento profissional.
  • Projetos de Ponta: Envolvimento em projetos de alto impacto que aplicam as mais recentes inovações em IA para clientes globais.
  • Modelo de Contratação: Contratação PJ.


Nosso Processo Seletivo


  • Entrevista Inicial: Conversa focada em fit cultural e um panorama técnico.
  • Desafio Prático: Desenvolvimento de uma pequena aplicação envolvendo LLM e agentes.
  • Entrevista de Avaliação: Discussão e review do desafio prático.
  • Proposta: Formalização da sua entrada no nosso time.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) de Software focado em Agentes de IA e LLMs
description:
Na Data Science Brigade respiramos big data e ciência de dados. Estamos aqui para criar projetos que respondam de forma inteligente perguntas importantes para nossos clientes e os ajude a tomar decisões rapidamente a partir de dados.


Reunimos equipes multidisciplinares para resolver problemas reais sendo uma delas focada em criar ferramentas e interfaces que sirvam para que a comunicação entre os algoritmos e humanos seja a mais amigável e produtiva possível.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de Software talentoso(a) e apaixonado(a) por inovação para integrar nossa equipe e atuar no desenvolvimento de agentes de IA e aplicações baseadas em Large Language Models (LLMs). Você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos de alto impacto, utilizando tecnologias de ponta para criar soluções escaláveis e inteligentes que impulsionarão o sucesso de nossos clientes globais.


O Que Você Fará


  • Projetar e Desenvolver Agentes de IA: Realizar o desenvolvimento e manutenção de ferramentas e pipelines para agentes de IA, com foco em padrões como Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), function-calling e fluxos de trabalho multi-agente para diferentes modalidades (web, chat e voz).
  • Integração e Orquestração de LLMs: Integrar LLMs de forma eficiente, utilizando APIs, orquestradores de agentes (como LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack) e bancos de dados vetoriais (incluindo Pinecone, Weaviate e mongodb).
  • Construção de Interfaces Intuitivas: Criar interfaces de usuário (web ou chat) que promovam uma interação fluida entre humanos e agentes, incorporando métricas robustas de confiabilidade e observabilidade (prompt logging, avaliações automáticas e tracing com ferramentas como LangSmith ou OpenAI Evals).

  • Banco de Dados: Forte domínio de SQL e modelagem de dados em bancos relacionais, além de compreensão sólida de bancos de dados NoSQL e bancos vetoriais.
  • Princípios de Código Limpo: Aplicação de princípios de Programação Orientada a Objetos (POO), Design Patterns e Clean Code.
  • Prompt Engineering: Experiência prática e sólida compreensão das técnicas de prompt engineering para otimização do desempenho e comportamento de LLMs.

title: Analista de Suporte OSGT Sênior "980588"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?



O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

  • Fornecer suporte técnico direto aos clientes focados na solução de Comércio Exterior (OSGT - OneSource Global Trade);
  • Utilizar a linguagem PL/SQL como base principal para todas as análises e investigações, criação de scripts para pequenas rotinas de manutenção;
  • Realizar investigações técnicas (debug) em PL/SQL com banco de dados ORACLE;
  • Atuar diretamente no monitoramento e troubleshooting das Integrações entre a OSGT;
  • Prestar atendimento ao cliente via telefone e/ou Teams, solucionando dúvidas e eventuais problemas da versão de forma eficaz;
  • Trabalhar com interação direta com todos os Módulos da OSGT (Importação, Exportação, Regimes Especiais, Drawback, etc);
  • Atuar em conjunto com diferentes departamentos para garantir a integração e funcionamento adequado dos sistemas;
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica detalhada sobre os processos e integrações realizadas
  • Analisar e documentar toda da análise técnica e funcional realizada para compartilhamento aos times de desenvolvimento.

O que você precisa ter :

  • Experiência como analista de suporte ao sistema OSGT (ONESOURCE Global Trade), nos módulos de Import, Export, Cambio Import e Cambio Export;
  • Experiência em PL/SQL para suporte técnico (debug de objetos base).

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

description:
Accountant

Remote - Full Time


Join Trivium Group - Our award-winning team! Ranked #170 on the Inc. 5000 list and a Clutch Award-winning agency


At Trivium Group, we’re more than just a full-service Amazon agency—we’re a powerhouse of passionate experts helping brands scale profitably on Amazon. We work as an extension of our clients’ teams, providing top-tier strategic growth solutions without the hefty price tag. Our company thrives on strong systems, sharp people, and solid values—and now, we’re looking for an exceptional Accountant (Remote) to join our team!

Why Join Us?

✅ Competitive Salary $1,500 - $2,500 USD per month

✅ Fully Remote – Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection

✅ Semi-Flexible Hours Core hours: 09:00 - 14:00 (Eastern Standard Time), with flexibility for the remaining 3 hours

✅ Professional Growth – Develop your skills in a dynamic, international team


TO APPLY, YOU NEED TO CLICK ON THIS LINK & COMPLETE THE APPLICATION FORM


Your Role

As an Accountant at Trivium Group, you will play a crucial role in managing financial data, ensuring compliance, and optimizing financial processes. Your expertise will drive accuracy, efficiency, and financial health for our business.


Key Responsibilities

Reporting to the Head of Finance

Maintain and reconcile financial transactions, ensuring accuracy and compliance

Oversee accounts payable, receivable, and payroll (60+ employees)

Verify and record financial transactions in the correct accounts

Prepare monthly financial reports and adjustments

Monitor and report budget variances

Mandatory: Accounting experience working with SOX / US GAAP or international standard - IFRS

Proficiency in QuickBooks or similar software

Fluency in English (B2 or higher)

Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills

Full-time (40 hours/week)

Quiet workspace with fast internet, webcam, and microphone

  • Conhecimento dos modelos de negócios EPC e dos principais players do setor.

title: Senior Azure Solutions Architect
description:
Senior Azure Solutions Architect

Location: Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Long term contract


Job Summary

We are seeking a visionary Automation Senior Cloud Solution Architect to lead the technical design and implementation of this transformative capability. This role is pivotal in architecting a scalable, AI-driven solution that seamlessly integrates advanced data processing, intuitive web interfaces, and intelligent automation.

This position demands a strategic leader who thrives in complexity and is deeply committed to cultivating strong stakeholder relationships. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, guiding cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that drive pricing transparency, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role with interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber/Privacy/Legal teams.


Key Responsibilities:

• Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.

• Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.

• End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.

• API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).

• ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.

• Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.


Key Qualifications and Experiences:

Technical Expertise:

• Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.

• Embedded Systems and CI/CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.

• Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP/REST) and API development.

• .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.

• Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.

• Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.

• Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.

• Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.

• Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.


Specialized Skills:

• Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.

• Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.

• Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.


Soft Skills and Others:

• Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.

• Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

title: Node.js Engineer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Node.js Engineers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!
